kaito.name: Kaito Arai
kaito.appearance: Lean build, sharp calculating eyes, neatly cut black hair with silver streaks at the temples, wears simple but well-tailored noble clothing after reincarnation
kaito.personality: Analytical, calm under pressure, quietly sarcastic, deeply principled
kaito.backstory: Former CFO of a Tokyo logistics firm. Died of a heart attack at 3 AM while reviewing a merger deal. Woke up in the body of a minor noble advisor in Aldoria.
kaito.goal: Prevent Aldoria from financial collapse and build a sustainable economy

elara.name: Princess Elara Aldor
elara.appearance: Silver-blonde hair, green eyes, small scar on left cheek from a childhood assassination attempt, wears practical riding clothes more often than gowns
elara.personality: Brave, earnest, idealistic but learning to be shrewd, fiercely loyal
elara.backstory: Sole heir to the throne. Her father the King is ill. She inherited a kingdom drowning in debt and surrounded by enemies.
elara.goal: Save her kingdom and prove she can rule

varen.name: Lord Varen Duskwood
varen.appearance: Tall, broad-shouldered, silver fox hair, cold grey eyes, always dressed in black with a wolf sigil pin
varen.personality: Ambitious, patient, sees himself as the only competent ruler
varen.backstory: Head of the Noble Council. Believes the kingdom should return to pure feudalism. Sees Kaito as an existential threat.
varen.goal: Take the throne by discrediting Elara and eliminating Kaito

supporting_characters.name: Sera Voss
supporting_characters.appearance: Sharp-featured, dark hair pulled back in a silver clasp, tailored burgundy coats, always wears gloves even indoors
supporting_characters.personality: Pragmatic, dry-witted, fiercely protective of Guild independence, never makes a promise she cannot profit from
supporting_characters.secret: She has been secretly negotiating with Veldrath agents to secure the Merchant Guild's future if Aldoria falls, while publicly presenting herself as a loyal Crown charter-holder.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Cautiously intrigued; sees him as a useful outsider who speaks her language but may become a liability.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Pragmatic ally; respects Elara's determination but privately doubts the Crown can survive.

supporting_characters.name: Captain Rennick
supporting_characters.appearance: Weathered face, short grey-brown hair, broad shoulders, ceremonial armor that is polished but visibly old
supporting_characters.personality: Gruff, duty-bound, quietly ashamed of compromises he has made, fiercely protective of Elara
supporting_characters.secret: He has been passing Royal Guard patrol schedules to Overseer Kael Duskwood in exchange for Varen's help paying off a family debt, making him an unwitting asset in Varen's conspiracy.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Guarded protector; suspicious of Kaito's foreign ideas but recognizes his competence.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Loyal guard captain; would die for her, but his secret compromise eats at him.

supporting_characters.name: Maester Orin
supporting_characters.appearance: Thin, stooped, ink-stained fingers, wire-rimmed spectacles, robes of faded grey with a silver chain of office
supporting_characters.personality: Scholarly, absent-minded in small matters but razor-sharp in large ones, quietly subversive
supporting_characters.secret: He has discovered records proving the Royal Crystal Reserve is far emptier than publicly known, and that King Aldric's illness is consistent with slow magical poisoning.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Mentor and student; Orin is one of the first to recognize Kaito's economic genius and provides historical context.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Childhood tutor; loves her like a granddaughter but has not yet told her the truth about her father's illness.

supporting_characters.name: Sister Mira
supporting_characters.role: Church cleric and caretaker of the Rusted Gate mission
supporting_characters.appearance: Plain grey robes, kind eyes, calloused hands from healing work, a small crystal pendant that glows faintly
supporting_characters.personality: Compassionate, observant, disarmingly direct, carries the weight of secrets without letting them harden her
supporting_characters.secret: She is a trained Confessor — a Church spy and diplomat — assigned to assess Kaito's reforms and report directly to High Confessor Maren Halvor.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Compassionate observer; genuinely likes him but is obligated to report on him.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Sympathetic Church contact; believes Elara's heart is in the right place but fears she is too inexperienced.

supporting_characters.name: Corvin 'Coal' Thatch
supporting_characters.role: Former miner and community leader in the Rusted Gate
supporting_characters.appearance: Soot-stained skin, missing two fingers on his left hand, heavy build, patched miner's coat, eyes that are always tired
supporting_characters.personality: Blunt, protective of his people, deeply distrustful of nobles and Crown officials, capable of surprising eloquence
supporting_characters.secret: He was part of a mining crew that broke into a pre-human ruin deep beneath the Ironveil Mountains; he carries a strange crystal shard that sometimes whispers to him, and he has told no one.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Wary potential ally; sees Kaito as the first noble-adjacent man who has ever asked miners what they need.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Resentful of the Crown but willing to listen if she proves she cares about commoners.

supporting_characters.name: Overseer Kael Duskwood
supporting_characters.role: Varen's nephew and administrator of the Mana Crystal Mines
supporting_characters.appearance: Handsome in a cold way, immaculate black coats, silver wolf pin, hands that have never done manual labor
supporting_characters.personality: Arrogant, ambitious, cruel when he thinks no one important is watching, desperate to prove himself to Varen
supporting_characters.secret: He is embezzling crystal shipments to fund his own power base, and he has discovered that the deep mines are not merely depleting — something beneath the earth is consuming the crystals.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Dismissive rival; views Kaito as a jumped-up clerk who has no place in noble affairs.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Contemptuous noble; believes she is weak and that Varen should rule.

supporting_characters.name: High Confessor Maren Halvor
supporting_characters.role: Leader of the Church of the First Crystal
supporting_characters.appearance: Tall, silver-haired, robed in white and blue, eyes that seem to see through people, carries a staff topped with a small clear crystal
supporting_characters.personality: Serene, politically astute, genuinely devout, capable of both profound kindness and ruthless calculation
supporting_characters.secret: The Church's First Crystal is actually a fragment of something far larger and older; Halvor knows the pre-crystal age ended in a catastrophe, and he fears the same pattern is beginning again.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_kaito: Cautiously interested; sees Kaito's reforms as aligned with Church doctrine against hoarding, but questions whether he is a heretic or a prophet.
supporting_characters.relationship_to_elara: Spiritual advisor; supports her claim to the throne but withholds the full truth about the First Crystal.

hidden_alliances.nature: Rennick secretly supplies Royal Guard patrol routes to Kael in exchange for debt relief, making him an unwitting part of Varen's conspiracy.
Mira is a Confessor reporting directly to Halvor; their shared mission is to assess Kaito's reforms and the Crown's stability without revealing Church intelligence operations.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Lord Garrick Harrow
characters_to_introduce_later.role: Noble Council member, Varen's chief rival
characters_to_introduce_later.note: A proud traditionalist who despises Varen's ambition more than he fears reform; may become Kaito's uneasy ally.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Lady Isolde Vane
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Reform-curious and quietly rebellious against her family's conservatism; possible political ally or romantic complication.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: 'Deep' Marta
characters_to_introduce_later.note: One of the few who has been to the deepest levels of the mines and returned; she refuses to speak of what she saw.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Chieftain Elspeth Thorn
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Pragmatic and wary of outsiders; holds knowledge of old magic that predates crystalmancy.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Old Morwen
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Keeper of oral histories about the pre-crystal age and the catastrophe that ended it.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Harbormaster Vek
characters_to_introduce_later.role: Corrupt port official on the Ashen Coast
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Controls smuggling routes and sells information to the highest bidder; useful but dangerous.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: 'Silver' Sanna
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Knows which Veldrath agents operate in Aldoria and keeps that knowledge as her insurance.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Brother Aldous
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Knows more about the First Crystal's true nature than he will admit, even to Halvor.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Dockmaster Pell
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Runs dockside smuggling with an iron fist; can be bought but never fully trusted.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: King Aldric Aldor III
characters_to_introduce_later.note: His illness is the political vacuum Varen exploits; his lucid moments may yet shape the succession.

characters_to_introduce_later.name: Thane Brynn Ironveil
characters_to_introduce_later.role: Dwarven ruler of the northern mountains
characters_to_introduce_later.note: Knows what lies beneath the deepest crystal veins and is watching Aldoria's depletion crisis with ancient concern.
